answer: raven holds one escalating bond floor: a comet is admitted only by burning ember equal to the current floor and raising that floor to double. The kth admission burns twice the previous price, so n clones cost 2^n - 1 ember, with the bill attached to each admission in raven. Because every admission reads and writes the single floor in raven, batches cannot be split or run in parallel. It breaks if the floor can be forked or ember is refundable.
